title: 第五章 下马威你配吗第六章 她凭什么
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
沈母终于忍不住，挣脱沈父的手，含泪上前：“如卿，我是妈妈啊，你受苦了。”
她伸出手，想要去触碰那个看起来一碰就碎的女儿。
然而，沈如卿后退半步，动作轻柔却坚定地避开了她的拥抱。
她那双湿漉漉的鹿眼中没有期待，只有一片平静的疏离：“沈夫人，初次见面，您好。”
这一声“沈夫人”，生疏得像是一把刀，让沈母僵在原地。
她的手悬在半空，眼泪瞬间掉了下来，满脸的受伤与愧疚：“如卿，你…你是在怪妈妈吗？”
沈父见状，眉头紧皱。
原本盘算的利益瞬间被这一声“沈夫人”打破，属于一家之主的威严让他厉声呵斥：“放肆！
这是你母亲，就算是没在沈家长大，连规矩都不懂吗？
一回来就气你母亲，这就是你的教养？”
沈如卿在心底冷笑。
教养？
把亲生女儿扔在贫民窟不闻不问，把假千金捧在手心如珠如宝，这就是沈家的教养？
她抬起头，那张绝美的小脸上带着三分怯意，但说出的话却字字珠玑：“我自小就是个孤儿。
是在垃圾堆里抢食长大，自然没什么教养可言。
沈先生若是如此厌恶我，我离开就是了。”
说着，她作势要转身。
“放肆！你什么态度！”沈父气得脸色铁青，抬起了手就要教训这个不知天高地厚的逆女。
沈如卿冷漠的看着他，嗤笑道：“你以什么身份打我？我从未想过回来你们沈家，明明是你们亏欠我。
怎么，我一回来，就想施父亲的威风？

我配钥匙的，你配吗？”
“你！”沈父气的眼睛瞪得溜圆，气的脸红脖子粗。
“父亲，妹妹刚回来，可能还不适应，您别吓着她。”
一道温润如玉的声音适时响起，伸手拦住了沈父要打下去的手。
说话的是沈家大哥沈墨，他穿着一身得体的灰色西装，鼻梁上戴着金丝眼镜，目光温和地打量着这个找回来的妹妹。
他并没有因为她的衣着寒酸而露出鄙夷，反而带着几分愧疚和善意。
但这善意背后藏着什么，只有他自己知道。
沈如卿对这个大哥点了点头，算是打过招呼，态度依旧不冷不热。
反正她也没打算在这个家久待，这里对她来说，不过是一个暂时的跳板。
“什么妹妹？我只有若冰姐一个姐姐！”
一个暴躁充满敌意的声音突然插了进来，打破了短暂的平静。
是沈家最小的儿子沈宇，一个十足的蠢货。
他染着一头嚣张的黄毛，一脸敌意地瞪着沈如卿，像护食的小兽一样挡在一个白裙少女身前，仿佛沈如卿是什么洪水猛兽。
那少女正是假千金，沈若冰。
她也是一只兔子兽人，不过她是s级精神力。
此刻她穿着昂贵的高定白裙，妆容精致，整个人看起来柔弱又高贵，浑身散发着一种让人忍不住想要呵护的怜惜气息。
沈如卿在心底啧啧两声。
不愧是原po文的女主，的确有股子那味儿。
这小白莲的气质，拿捏得死死的。
沈若冰眼圈红红的，轻轻拉了拉沈宇的袖子，声音哽咽，仿佛受了天大的委屈：“小宇，别这样……

这本来就是姐姐的家，是我……
是我占了姐姐的位置，姐姐怨我也是应该的。
只要姐姐能消气，我……
content_en:
Mother Shen finally couldn't help it, broke away from Father Shen's hand, and stepped forward with tears in her eyes: "Ruqing, I am your mother, you have suffered."
She stretched out her hand, wanting to touch the daughter who looked like she would be broken at the touch of a touch.
However, Shen Ruqing took half a step back, gently but firmly avoiding her embrace.
There was no expectation in her wet deer eyes, only a calm detachment: "Mrs. Shen, this is our first time meeting you. Hello."
The sound of "Mrs. Shen" was as unfamiliar as a knife, making Mother Shen freeze in place.
Her hands were hanging in the air, tears fell instantly, and her face was full of hurt and guilt: "Ruqing, you...are you blaming mom?"
Father Shen frowned when he saw this.
The benefits he originally planned were instantly shattered by the words "Mrs. Shen", and the majesty of the head of the family made him sternly yell: "Presumptuous!
This is your mother. Even if she didn't grow up in the Shen family, doesn't she even understand the rules?
Is this your upbringing to make your mother angry as soon as you come back? "
Shen Ruqing sneered in her heart.
Education?
Throwing his own daughter in the slums without paying attention, and holding the fake daughter in the palm of his hand like a pearl, is this the upbringing of the Shen family?
She raised her head, with a hint of timidity on her beautiful little face, but her words were precise: "I have been an orphan since I was a child.
He grew up fighting for food in garbage dumps, so he naturally had no education at all.
If Mr. Shen hates me so much, I will just leave. "
As she said this, she made a gesture to turn around.
"Presumptuous! What's your attitude!" Father Shen's face turned livid with anger, and he raised his hand to teach this rebellious girl a lesson.
Shen Ruqing looked at him indifferently and sneered: "In what capacity do you hit me? I never thought of coming back to your Shen family. It's obviously you who owe me.
Why, as soon as I come back, do I want to use my father’s authority?
I match the key, do you match it? "
"You!" Father Shen's eyes widened with anger, his face turned red and his neck became thick with anger.
"Father, my sister has just come back and may not be used to it yet. Don't scare her."
A voice as gentle as jade sounded at the right time, and he reached out to stop Father Shen's hand that was about to strike.
The speaker was Shen Mo, the eldest brother of the Shen family. He was wearing a decent gray suit and gold-rimmed glasses on his nose. He looked at the found sister with gentle eyes.
He didn't show disdain for her shabby clothes, but instead showed a bit of guilt and kindness.
But what lies behind this kindness, only he knows.
Shen Ruqing nodded to this elder brother as a greeting, but his attitude was still lukewarm.
Anyway, she didn't plan to stay in this home for a long time. This place was just a temporary springboard for her.
"What sister? I only have one sister, Sister Ruobing!"
A violent and hostile voice suddenly broke in, breaking the brief calm.
It's Shen Yu, the youngest son of the Shen family, a complete idiot.
He had arrogant yellow hair and stared at Shen Ruqing with hostility. He stood in front of a girl in a white dress like a little beast guarding her food, as if Shen Ruqing was some kind of savage beast.
That girl is none other than the fake daughter, Shen Ruobing.
She is also a rabbit beastman, but she has S-level mental power.
At this moment, she was wearing an expensive high-end white dress with exquisite makeup. She looked weak and noble, and exuded an aura of compassion that made people want to care for her.
Shen Ruqing clicked her tongue twice in her heart.
As expected of the heroine in the original post, she does smell like a pussy.
This Xiao Bailian's temperament is very well controlled.
Shen Ruobing's eyes were red, and she gently pulled Shen Yu's sleeve, her voice choked with sobs, as if she had been greatly wronged: "Xiaoyu, don't be like this...
This is my sister's home, it's me...
It was me who took my sister's position, and it was right for my sister to blame me.
